meta.title: NEVVOH Pricing — Task management starting from a low per-user price
meta.description: Discover NEVVOH plans: monthly billing per user, minimum of 10 seats and 14-day free trial without a credit card.

hero.subtitle: No fine print. Pay only for your team's seats and cancel anytime.

noPlans: No plans available at the moment.

items.a: Yes. You can cancel your subscription anytime from the billing panel. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: 14 full days with access to all modules, no credit card required. At the end, you decide whether to activate the subscription.
NEVVOH was designed for teams. The 10-seat minimum ensures room to grow and effective collaboration between members from day one.

items.q: Can I increase or decrease seats later?
items.a: Yes. From the billing panel you adjust the number of seats when needed and the next invoice is automatically recalculated.
Currently payments are processed manually by our sales team. Automatic checkout with card and Pix is coming soon.
